mapper.sql: id, out_table_abs_id, loan_contract_code, contract_code, client_code, client_name, org_id, financial_contract_status, receivable_rent, receivable_residual_value, receivable_outtax, unrealized_revenue, lessee_margin, voucher_id, error_info, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, transfer_price,period_code
mapper.select:
with abs as ( select * from eg_out_table_contract_detail t1 where exists (select 1 from ( select eotcd.org_id ,eotcd.contract_code ,max(eotcd.create_time) create_time from eg_out_table_contract_detail eotcd
join eg_out_table_abs eota on eotcd.out_table_abs_id = eota.id where eota.process_status in ('2','3','4') group by eotcd.org_id ,eotcd.contract_code )tmp where t1.org_id = tmp.org_id and t1.contract_code = tmp.contract_code and t1.create_time = tmp.create_time) ) select abs.org_id,abs.contract_code,abs.loan_contract_code loan_contract_code from abs join eg_ta_reclassification_detail etrd on coalesce(abs.org_id,'') = coalesce(etrd.org_id ,'') and coalesce(abs.contract_code,'') = coalesce(etrd.contract_code ,'') where etrd.ta_reclassification_id = #{taId}
